name: Vegetarians
overview: Scripture presents vegetarianism as a lifestyle choice recognized from the beginning, where God provided plants and fruits for food, as seen in Genesis 1:29. While after the flood God permitted eating meat (Genesis 9:3), the initial provision underscores a diet without flesh. The Bible also values the quality of fellowship and love over the abundance of meat, illustrated in Proverbs 15:17, and envisions harmony among creatures in Isaiah 11:6, reflecting a peaceful creation. Dietary laws in Leviticus and Deuteronomy further distinguish acceptable food, highlighting a God-ordained order in eating practices.
